name: Ula'elek and the Brutal Gauntlets
summary: Thun'grim Firegaze sends you from the Barrens to Sen'jin Village for the Brutal Gauntlets. There, Darkspear craftsman Ula'elek will forge them.

sections.title: A Journey to the Coast
sections.body: Thun'grim Firegaze sends you east after you prove your valor in the Barrens and begin assembling the Brutal Armor set. The veteran orc smith relies on skilled artisans across Horde lands instead of forging every piece at his mountain perch. For the heavy mail gauntlets, he directs you to Durotar's rocky southern shores.

sections.title: The Eyes of the Loa
sections.body: In Sen'jin Village, troll armorsmith Ula'elek works among his Darkspear kin. Thun'grim has already told him of your deeds, and Ula'elek says the spirits have watched your triumphs in battle. For a warrior earning a place among the Horde's elite, fine craft and spiritual acknowledgement go hand in hand.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Ula'elek and the Brutal Gauntlets?
aliases: who starts ula'elek and the brutal gauntlets
faq.answer: Thun'grim Firegaze, an orc armorer atop the mountains in the Barrens, gives you the task.
You can find Ula'elek in Sen'jin Village on Durotar's southern coast.

faq.q: What is the Brutal Armor set?
faq.answer: Brutal Armor is a custom mail set for seasoned Horde warriors around their thirtieth season. Allied smiths across Kalimdor craft its pieces.
After welcoming you and acknowledging your deeds in battle, Ula'elek asks you to gather the exotic materials for the Brutal Gauntlets, starting with Satyr Hooves.

faq.q: Why does Thun'grim send you to a troll armorsmith?
faq.answer: Thun'grim shares the Brutal Armor set's forging among the Horde's finest specialized smiths, including Darkspear craftsman Ula'elek, who makes the gauntlets.

faq.q: Do Alliance players have an equivalent to this quest?
faq.answer: Alliance warriors undertake a similar martial trial to craft class-specific armor, but the Brutal Armor chain and Ula'elek's work belong to the Horde.

angles.text: As a Horde warrior, assembling the Brutal Armor marks your passage toward becoming a battle-hardened frontline champion.
As a troll, Ula'elek's work shows how Darkspear smithing and spiritual attunement aid the Horde war effort.
As a member of the Horde, you see orc smiths in the Barrens and troll smiths in Durotar work together, binding Thrall's young coalition.
